basic_info: 42-year-old female. Chief complaint: Pain in the right index finger following a skiing injury on Saturday.
present_illness: The patient injured her right index finger while skiing on Saturday. The pain has persisted for about five days and is rated as seven out of 10. There is no swelling, bruising, or discoloration, but there is aching pain, and the finger hurts when moved or touched. The pain is localized to the tip of the finger and is exacerbated by movement or touch. The patient reports difficulty in fully bending the finger without pain. No deformity, numbness, tingling, or weakness has been reported. The patient has started taking ibuprofen, but it has not provided significant pain relief. An X-ray of the right index finger was performed and showed no fractures or dislocations. The stiffness is mainly when I try to bend the finger, and it's hard to make a fist or grip things. The pain gets worse when I move it or touch it, especially when someone presses on it or when I try to flex it. It doesn't really hurt when it's just sitting still, though.
past_history: No prior fractures or injuries to the right index finger. No history of deformity, numbness, tingling, or weakness in the finger. No prior medical evaluation for this injury. No history of rheumatoid arthritis or lupus. No previous episodes of similar pain or swelling in the same finger or other fingers. No history of systemic symptoms such as fatigue, fever, or weight loss. No family history of rheumatological conditions reported.
physical_exam: Physical examination: Vital signs are stable. Inspection of the right index finger reveals no deformity, swelling, bruising, or discoloration. Palpation elicits localized tenderness at the tip of the finger. Range of motion is limited due to pain, with difficulty in fully bending the finger. No numbness, tingling, or weakness is noted in the finger. Neurovascular examination is intact.
aux_exam: X-ray of the right index finger was performed and showed no fractures or dislocations. No other imaging or laboratory tests have been performed yet.
